en-US.name: DMS Desktop
en-US.releaseNotes:
Signed NSIS installer for Windows. Verify the SHA-256 sidecar next to the binary before installing.
dms-desktop-admx.zip is the Group Policy / Intune administrative template; it is not required on endpoints.
See docs/windows-entra-deployment.md for deployment and docs/changes/active/CHG-0024-windows-nsis-installer-release.md for the installer contract.
